findings.action: Create the checkpoint artifact before the no-ff merge or reword the sentence to point at an existing file (e.g. target/f16/baseline.json and the evidence JSON).
findings.claim: Spec directs readers to target/f16/checkpoint.json before the next interval, but no such file exists in the worktree (Glob target/f16/checkpoint.json returned nothing; target/f16 holds baseline/inventory/review artifacts only).

findings.action: Add module_config_get to the before/after table as a no-code-change consumer whose reply framing moves from simple to bulk (matching native CONFIG GET), and add a selected config-get check to the SDK helper regressions gate.
findings.claim: The direct SDK migration list names version_from_info and is_enterprise_internal only. src/configuration.rs:589-606 module_config_get also routes native CONFIG GET replies through From<&CallResult> and returns them for module emission, so today valid config values are re-emitted as CString simple strings and under the proposal become bulk; this observable consequence is unlisted even though evidence hashes configuration.rs.

findings.action: List target/f16/reference-excerpts.json (with its sha256) in retained_artifacts so the reference-table evidence basis is ledgered alongside the inventory.
findings.claim: retained_artifacts omits target/f16/reference-excerpts.json (and pre-review-checks.json), yet the spec's reference table and this review's reference claims rest on that excerpt file and its per-file source_sha256 values.

findings.action: Tighten the four cited ranges to the exact lines so the caller's hash/line checks and future diffs anchor precisely.
findings.claim: Minor line-range drift: Context::call is mod.rs:432-435 (cited 432-436); the StringBuffer emitter arm ends at mod.rs:547 (cited range ends 546); 7.2.8 callReplyGetString spans call_reply.c:299-315 (cited 298-317); 8.10.2 bulk/error/simple parsers span 69-88 (cited 69-87). Content claims are correct.

findings.action: Name tests/integration.rs:701 as the retained explicit SimpleString control in the gate and specify adding a BulkString sibling case rather than replacing it.
findings.claim: The SDK helper regressions gate asks for pure version-parser tests on old explicit and new bulk text but does not note that tests/integration.rs:701 already constructs RedisValue::SimpleString(info) for version_from_info; that existing call is the retained explicit-text control and must keep passing after the migration.
